name: Issues
description: Per-repository issues, optionally filed against a project: a numbered list, open or closed, with tools for agents and an Issues tab

tools.name: list
tools.description: List the repository's issues, newest first, without their bodies; with project, only that project's.

project.description: Only this project's issues: a root path (crates/lsp), as the kernel passes it

tools.name: get
tools.description: One issue by its number, with its body; with project, not found unless it is that project's.

project.description: The project it must belong to: a root path (crates/lsp), as the kernel passes it

tools.name: create
tools.description: Open an issue in the repository, in a project when given. The caller is its author.

project.description: The project to file it against: a root path (crates/lsp), as the kernel passes it

tools.name: close
tools.description: Close an issue by its number (idempotent); with project, not found unless it is that project's.

project.description: The project it must belong to: a root path (crates/lsp), as the kernel passes it

tools.name: reopen
tools.description: Reopen a closed issue by its number (idempotent); with project, not found unless it is that project's.

project.description: The project it must belong to: a root path (crates/lsp), as the kernel passes it
